scope: Real MySQL + loopback TCP SMTP receiver. Claims, permission/address/status rechecks, retry 1/5/15 minutes, concurrent workers, expired leases, crash ambiguity and stable Message-ID. No real external mailbox/TLS provider/Windows/Docker/LAN verification.
